claim_text: under verbatim queries with 20% character noise character n-gram BM25 (MRR = 0.4703) significantly outperforms word BM25 (0.3694 pHolm = 0.0011) and dense models (0.1345)
notes: Confirmed on synthetic character noise; however on clean OCR and real degraded OCR word BM25 outperforms character n-grams (0.832 vs 0.731 clean 0.668 vs 0.591 degraded). Scope qualification required.

claim_text: Under natural light paraphrasing however word BM25 collapses by 76% (MRR = 0.0875) where hybrid dense-sparse fusion and clean visual streams take over (p < 0.01)
notes: Hybrid+CLIP reaches 0.1249 vs Hybrid 0.1114 (pHolm=0.0105 vs Hybrid not <0.01). No direct paired permutation test vs BM25 was executed. The 0.125 figure is unrounded.

claim_text: Dense proxy collapse is driven by a discrete tokenization bottleneck: character corruption induces a +122% explosion in WordPiece subword fragmentation (1.347 to 2.994 subwords/word) and catastrophic embedding drift (cosine similarity drops to 0.4655 at 20% noise) causing dense bi-encoders to fail completely on numeric identifiers (MRR = 0.033) and short entities (0.068)
notes: Requires verification whether dense collapse is an artifact of sequence truncation beyond 512 tokens on receipt documents. Phase 1.2 will test chunked dense retrieval (MaxP).

claim_text: second-stage cross-encoder cascades (BGE-reranker) provide the largest performance lift (+0.0522 clean +0.0460 noise MRR p = 0.0011)
notes: Gains confirmed across clean and noisy regimes. Note p=0.0011 reflects permutation floor at 10000 iterations; Phase 1.5 will re-evaluate with >=100000 permutations.

claim_text: heuristic reliability weighting fails (MRR drops to 0.3574 vs. 0.3694 p < 0.01) with observable reliability AUROC inverting from 0.9948 on synthetic noise to 0.2674 on optical degradation
notes: AUROC inversion from 0.9948 to 0.2674 confirmed on held-out test split. Phase 1.3 will examine if Apple Vision language correction explains this inversion.

claim_text: On 2754 pooled queries across 200 random splits distribution-free conformal cascade calibration guarantees non-escalated miss rates <= 0.05 (empirical 0.0579 UCB 0.0529) at an 89.5% escalation rate reducing latency by 10% vs. Always-Escalate while increasing MRR (0.3527 vs. 0.3485)
notes: Both empirical test miss (0.0579) and UCB (0.0529) exceed the 0.05 target. Only 36.5% to 37.0% of splits satisfy miss rate <= 0.05. Stating that the cascade guarantees miss rate <= 0.05 is factually contradicted by the data.

claim_text: On N=1000 MS-COCO Karpathy-test images native visual retrieval (CLIP ViT-B/32 MRR = 0.4709 Hit@10 = 0.7570) decisively outperforms machine caption proxies (MiniLM MRR = 0.3728 Hit@10 = 0.6530; all pHolm = 0.00040)
notes: Native visual superiority confirmed across Hit@1, Hit@5, Hit@10, and MRR. Note p=0.00040 reflects permutation floor at 10000 iterations.

claim_text: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) confirm Grounded Extractive Bridging is statistically equivalent to Generative LLM Bridging (0.640 vs. 0.640 TargetHit@10 p_TOST = 0.00000 inside Delta = +-0.05) without generative API costs
notes: Software artifact: run_multihop_equivalence_v2.py line 149 literally set extractive_bridge_all = np.copy(llm_bridge_all). The 90% CI of [0 0] is an artifact of copying the array.

claim_text: Clean OCR character error rate CER = 0.4519 and word error rate WER = 0.6503; Realistic optical degradation CER = 0.5218 and WER = 0.7561
notes: Computed on unnormalized Levenshtein string comparisons with transposed bounding box line orders. Must recompute with normalized jiwer.

claim_text: H2 confirmed: learned query router beats All-Stream RRF (+0.1938 MRR)
notes: Contradicted by Section IV-I where learned routers lost to All-Stream RRF (0.4214 vs 0.392-0.407 pHolm=0.2646) and H2 was formally ruled KILLED. Router beat RRF in Sec V-D only because RRF was unnormalized.

notes: Stale legacy claim from 55-probe private split (Table VII). On public test split (Table tab:ablation_v2) BM25+Clean is 0.369 vs Hybrid 0.369 (no difference).

notes: Stale legacy claim from 55-probe private split. On public benchmark tau=0.384 and escalation rate is 89.5%.

claim_text: OCR character noise catastrophically degrades dense embeddings (MRR collapsing from 0.8527 to 0.3691 at 40% noise) while sparse inverted indices (BM25) maintain robust token matching (0.8993 MRR)
notes: Stale legacy numbers from 55-probe private split. On public test split clean MiniLM is 0.210 and 20% noise is 0.068.
